name: VRM_FAIR_PRICE_INTERIM
description: VRM_FAIR_PRICE_INTERIM contains information about fair market value calculation process.

columns.name: TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: Internal identifier of the template.

columns.name: FMV_PRICE_TYPE
columns.description: Fair market value price type. Price type can be either VSOE, TPE, or ESP. Values are from the lookup VRM_FMV_TYPES.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Currency code of the source document.

columns.name: DATA_SET_STATUS
columns.description: Status of a VSOE price set. Values are from the lookup VRM_VSOE_PRICE_SETS_STATUS.

columns.name: LINE_STATUS
columns.description: Status of a source document line.

columns.name: LINE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Line amount of the source document.

columns.name: QUANTITY
columns.description: Quantity of a transaction.

columns.name: PRICING_COMBINATION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the pricing dimension combination.

columns.name: MINIMUM_LINE_COUNT
columns.description: Minimum number of standalone sales required in order to calculate a valid VSOE price.

columns.name: TOLERANCE_PCT_RANGE_HIGH
columns.description: Higher limit of the VSOE fair price tolerance range in percentage.

columns.name: TOLERANCE_PCT_RANGE_LOW
columns.description: Lower limit of the VSOE fair price tolerance range in percentage.

columns.name: TOLERANCE_RANGE_COVERAGE
columns.description: The required minimum percentage of standalone sales that its unit selling price falls within tolerance range price of an item.

columns.name: USE_TOLERANCE_FOR_COMPLIANCE
columns.description: A flag that indicates if a tolerance range should be used during compliance validation process of a MEA line or not.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Internal unique identifier of a source document line.

columns.name: UOM_CODE
columns.description: Code name of the unit of measure.

columns.name: ITEM_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates the type of a source document items. The valid values are ITEM, MEMO_LINE and ITEM_GROUP.

columns.name: ITEM_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of an item type.

columns.name: MEDIAN_BASIS_VALUE
columns.description: The value used to calculate Median on a fair market representation which is derived using amount if the representation is 'absolute currency', or 'discount' if the representation is discounts.

columns.name: WORKER_NUMBER
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.

columns.name: MASTER_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Concurrent process request identifier of the master process.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: BATCH_NUMBER
columns.description: Identifies the batch to be processed.

columns.name: ELEMENT_TYPE
columns.description: Element is a deliverable or separate unit of accounting. Used to group element types for FMV sets. Values are from the lookup VRM_ELEMENT_TYPE.

columns.name: PERF_OBLIGATION_ID
columns.description: Performance obligation unique identifier.

columns.name: PERF_OBLIGATION_LINE_ID
columns.description: Performance obligation line unique identifier.

columns.name: AUTO_EXCLUSION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the line is used in standalone selling price calculation. Possible values are Y or N.

columns.name: AUTO_EXCLUSION_REASON_CODE
columns.description: Exclude a performance obligation line from observed standalone selling price calculation.
